mapper.select: SELECT TEMPLATE_KEY, TEMPLATE_NAME, TEMPLATE_TEXT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM ALERT_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE ORDER BY TEMPLATE_KEY ASC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO ALERT_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE target USING ( SELECT #{templateKey} AS TEMPLATE_KEY FROM DUAL ) source ON (target.TEMPLATE_KEY = source.TEMPLATE_KEY) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.TEMPLATE_NAME = #{templateName}, target.TEMPLATE_TEXT = #{templateText}, target.UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, target.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TEMPLATE_KEY, TEMPLATE_NAME, TEMPLATE_TEXT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{templateKey}, #{templateName}, #{templateText}, #{updatedBy}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
